title: #58 - Beat Him Again
content:
#58 - Beat Him Again

Chapter 58 Beat it again

"Seven hells!" King Robert sighed loudly.

"If there's not enough of a reason, I'm going to kiss your ass hard with my boots."

He was disheveled, sitting on the edge of the bed, staring at the man in gold robe.

The man in the golden robe who reported the news to the king kept his eyes fixed, pretending not to see the few ladies behind the king, and loudly reported to Robert about the fight between two groups of nobles.

"It's this stupid guy Cleo again. Is the Lannister family just so troubled?" Robert shouted loudly, with displeasure written all over his face.

He may have forgotten that Cleo is only a cousin of the Lannister family and does not share the same surname as the queen's family.

In the golden robe's narration, he only captured the key information about the queen's cousin, and then naturally thought that this was another bad thing done by the Lannister family.

Although he was unhappy that his bonding process with several women was interrupted, he quickly put on his clothes and prepared to go to the throne room to deal with the dispute.

Robert even made up his mind that as long as Cleo, the queen's cousin, was a little bit unreasonable, he would make the Lannister relatives pay the price.

To pay the price of interrupting his pleasure and having Jaime the Kingslayer standing outside the door listening to his calls.

When King Robert took the Kingsguard and other attendants to the throne room, a large group of people had already gathered inside, chattering about the matter.

"I think the people in Haijiang City are reasonable."

"Fart, it's just a commoner being bullied. The one being beaten is a noble, and one of them is the queen's cousin. How can Haijiang City be justified?"

"You are not a commoner, how can you speak to a noble?"

"It's not a question of who you're talking to, it's a universal rule!"

Most of the nobles also believed that the people in Haijiang City were unreasonable. After all, what Arthur and the others did violated the interests of most nobles.

Robert walked into the throne room from the back and nodded to Lord Eddard, Hand of the King, who had already sat down but stood up after seeing him. Then he walked up the steps and sat down on the huge, iron sword. on the finished chair.

The touch from his butt was so uncomfortable that it made Robert feel even worse.

"Quiet!" he shouted.

Perhaps a born warrior, Robert had an unusually loud voice.

After this loud shout, nearly a thousand people inside and outside the throne room immediately shut up, and the surrounding area became quiet.

"The one who was beaten tells the story first."

Robert naturally believed that Cleo was the one who beat the person, so he let the person who was beaten speak first.

This way you can avoid preconceptions.

But when he saw Cleo with blood on his forehead standing up and telling how he was beaten, he couldn't help but be slightly stunned.

Then his mood brightened a little.

Being able to see the Lannisters in ruins would make the king simply happy.

…

"Seven hells, I know you have to pay!" After listening to Cleo's story, Robert let out a loud sigh.

"It's not that I didn't pay, it was because she soiled my clothes first that her parents wanted her to spend the night with me." Cousin Cleo defended in a low voice.

In the story of Cleo and his cousin, the little girl soiled his clothes, and her parents thought of spending the night with him to compensate.

As for the subsequent fight, Arthur got angry and beat them up, and it was without any preparation on their part.

"If we are fully prepared, we can win." Cleo said without confidence.

"Then I still didn't pay. When I was young, I knew that I had to pay a golden dragon." Robert looked at the man with disgust, and then asked the attacker to come out and defend himself.

Arthur and the others looked left and right and pushed out the experienced Desmond.

"...That's the situation. Mr. Arthur dealt with him out of justice. As for the subsequent conflict, it was completely that Mr. Cleo wanted to blackmail us. He only brought the blame on himself."

Desmond overturned Cousin Cleo's lies very concisely, and told the reason of the matter pertinently.

"I also want to believe you, Sir the Master of Riverrun." Robert glanced at the mentioned Arthur, "But it's hard to convince me that he defeated twenty people by himself!"

In Robert's eyes, Arthur was just an ordinary little nobleman with a tall, thin body and a handsome face. How could one person defeat twenty people in a few breaths, and that was with bare hands.

Although he also wanted to make the Lannister relatives suffer.

"Your Majesty, you still have witnesses you can summon." Desmond pointed to the couple in the tavern.

Robert nodded and let the three of them speak.

Cleo stared at the tavern couple secretly, causing the latter's expression to change.

Under the watchful eyes of the audience, the couple in the tavern considered the words and hesitated for a long time, and they actually matched what Cleofon said.

"You see, even the client's statement in your mouth is different from your statement."

Robert tried very hard to defend Desmond's words. In fact, the tavern couple and Desmond's statements were completely opposite.

Arthur suddenly said at this time: "Why don't you think about the reason anymore?"

He took a few steps forward and walked to a place where everyone could see.

"It is precisely because of our rescue that we will not take revenge on the tavern couple, but Cleo, who suffered a loss, will come back to take revenge, so it is easy to understand who the two couples are talking to."

"You should use honorifics for His Majesty the King!" Barristan, the captain of the Kingsguard, reminded Arthur.

"No problem." Robert, wearing the crown, waved his hand, "What the young man said makes sense, but you still can't prove your statement. After all, it's hard for me to believe that you beat down twenty people by yourself."

"There is still one person who hasn't spoken." Arthur looked at the little girl, believing that she should be telling the truth.

Although the little girl still had two lines of tears on her face, she was not afraid of the stage at all. She stood up and told how Arthurs saved her from the clutches of the devil, and then how she fought back against Cleos righteously.

"I'm so confused." Robert looked at his good brother, Duke Eddard, "What do you think?"

"It sounds more reasonable for Mr. Arthur, but I can't believe that one person beat down twenty people in a blink of an eye."

Although Duke Eddard hated the behavior of his cousin Cleos, he also doubted the words of Arthur and Desmond.

As the guardian of the North, he has always believed in the old gods, but he firmly opposes the lord's right to the first night, and for this reason he even issued an order for the northern nobles to abolish this right.

"This is easy, the parties are all here, let them fight again."

Robert's brother, Lord Renly of Storm's End, came at some point and suggested with a chuckle.

"Great." Arthur also agreed, he also wanted to beat up Cleos and others again.
